svg.aria-label: Animated illustration of backpropagation through a multilayer perceptron
svg.text: Click to advance — after stage 5, click to restart

g.text: 1. Start from the loss at the output
Backpropagation begins with the derivative of the loss with respect to the prediction.
Use the transpose of the output weights and multiply by the local activation derivative.
Repeat the same rule: current-layer derivatives induce derivatives in the previous layer.
If needed, continue one step further to understand how the loss changes with the inputs.
Backpropagation is just repeated application of the chain rule from right to left.
